record_type_quote: To validate whether ORMDL3 is a risk factor for adult-onset asthma, we sought to replicate the association of polymorphisms in ORMDL3, GSDMB, ZPBP2 and IKZF3 and asthma in an adult Chinese Han population.

targets.authors: Moffatt MF, Kabesch M, Liang L, Dixon AL, Strachan D, Heath S, Depner M, von Berg A, Bufe A, Rietschel E
targets.title: Genetic variants regulating ORMDL3 expression contribute to the risk of childhood asthma
targets.evidence_quote: Recently, the first genome-wide association study (GWAS) of asthma in European subjects identified a novel region containing the ORM1-like 3 ( ORMDL3 ) gene at chromosome 17q21 strongly associated with childhood asthma and ORMDL3 transcript abundance [ 3 ].
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication study suggests that variants in 17q21 are significantly associated with risk of adult-onset asthma and gene expression in a Chinese Han population.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit replication conclusion and confirmation of the same association in an adult population.

reasoning: New case-control sample re-tests the initial association linked to reference 3. Later association papers describe the replication history rather than distinct designated targets.
